column1: # HLA pharmacogenetic risk alleles — CPIC/FDA drug-hypersensitivity associations.
# PUBLIC REFERENCE DATA — no individual's genotype here.
# Used by 13_hla.sh to flag which T1K-typed 2-field HLA alleles carry a drug
# hypersensitivity risk. Presence of the allele (carrier, dominant risk) is what
# matters — not zygosity. These are among the highest-value pharmacogenetic
# results and are completely invisible to a SNP/indel VCF.

column3: Abacavir CONTRAINDICATED (CPIC, FDA boxed warning) — abacavir hypersensitivity syndrome. Also flucloxacillin liver injury risk.
Avoid carbamazepine & oxcarbazepine (CPIC); caution phenytoin — Stevens-Johnson syndrome / toxic epidermal necrolysis (SJS/TEN). Highest risk in South/East Asian ancestry.
Carbamazepine hypersensitivity (SJS/TEN, DRESS, maculopapular exanthema) — consider an alternative (CPIC).
Allopurinol severe cutaneous adverse reaction (SCAR/SJS/TEN/DRESS) risk (CPIC) — consider alternative urate-lowering therapy.
